criteria.reasoning: Introduction clearly explains coral-reef monitoring need, fluid-lensing mission, single-satellite rationale, and users/operator. References support rationale. Some claims are broad but all required elements are present to a high standard.

criteria.name: Main body: mission design. Present a summary of the mission design using software and/or hand calculations as appropriate. requirements.where: Mission Design > Orbit; Mission Duration & EOL
Mission Design > Orbit; Ground Control & Communications

technical_issues.issue: Vega E is not yet operational; relying on a future launcher and unspecified rideshare creates schedule and interface risk.
Text says a very high altitude would yield low resolution images 'which is also desirable'; this is contradictory and should be undesirable.
RAAN initial value is said to indicate launch facility; RAAN at epoch depends on launch time/azimuth, not facility alone.
No swath/resolution calculation justifies 600 km for fluid lensing; 250 km reef width and daily coverage are not quantitatively linked.
No link budget, data rate, ground antenna band, or contact capacity calculation; average contact duration alone is insufficient evidence for data transfer.
Claim that descending path is constantly sunlit and used for imaging is not demonstrated; SSO eclipse and LTAN are not specified.
Drag-sail EOL is not sized or calculated; no demonstration of 25-year deorbit or re-entry casualty risk.
Five-year life is assumed without propulsion/station-keeping or drag/SSO drift assessment.
Only screenshots are provided; no STK/PIGI files or model parameters are included.
References are bare URLs, include Wikipedia, and [10] is malformed; no author/title/access dates.

overall: Adequate report: mission concept and major design areas are covered with STK screenshots, but technical inconsistencies, missing software files, weak references and unnumbered figures/tables prevent an accomplished rating.

feedback.summary: You present a clear coral-reef fluid-lensing concept and cover launch, orbit, ground station, duration and EOL with STK screenshots. The report is Adequate overall: C1 is strong, but C2-C4 need tighter technical evidence and presentation. Focus on quantified orbit/imaging and link-budget calculations, providing software files, sizing the drag sail, and professional referencing/numbering.
next_steps: Revise Mission Design > Orbit: remove the claim that high altitude gives low resolution 'which is also desirable', correct the RAAN explanation, and add a swath/resolution calculation linking 600 km to fluid-lensing reef coverage and daily revisit.

Strengthen Ground Control & Communications and Mission Duration & EOL: add a link budget with data rate, ground antenna band and contact capacity; specify SSO LTAN/eclipse; size the drag sail and show 25-year deorbit or casualty-risk compliance; justify five-year life with station-keeping/drag drift.

Improve evidence and presentation: include STK/PIGI files or model parameters for Images 1-5, number all figures/tables, replace bare URLs/Wikipedia with full references, fix [10], and expand the Conclusion to cover duration, EOL, users and single-satellite rationale.
